photo.caption: A woman sits on her bed in a classroom-turned-IDP camp in central Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray region, 4 June 2021.
photo.description: A woman sits on her bed in a classroom turned into a IDP camp in central Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray region, June 4, 2021. Like her, 200,000 people are displaced after fleeing the battles in Tigray. (Yan Boechat/VOA)

photo.fileTitle: File:4,000 POWs held by Tigray forces are released, May 2022.png
photo.caption: 4,000 prisoners of war held by Tigray forces on 19 May 2022.
photo.description: More than 4,000 prisoners of war who have been held in the Tigray Region for more than 11 months are being released to their families. The International Committee of the Red Cross is part of the process.
